pages.title: Chef Mentor
pages.creator: Solobuild P.C.
pages.description:
Chef Mentor connects match-three puzzles with a cookbook of dishes from around the world. Swap ingredients to form matches and complete dishes as you move through the kitchens of Greece, Italy, Mexico, France, and Japan. Finishing a dish unlocks its real recipe in the cookbook.

The collection contains 251 dishes, ranging from moussaka and carbonara to tacos, sushi, and ramen. Each country has its own map, music, and puzzle variations. Aim for three stars on the levels and collect stamps in a chef's passport while expanding the recipe collection.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Battle
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Brawl Stars Battle puts armed heroes and special abilities into team combat. In the three-against-three mode, help your side reach fifteen eliminations before the opposing team. Use gunfire and abilities to turn each encounter in your team's favor.

pages.title: Scary Shawarma Kiosk: The Anomaly
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Scary Shawarma Kiosk: The Anomaly makes you a night-shift worker deciding which customers to serve. Examine each visitor's appearance, speech and behavior for unusual details. Turn suspicious customers away by closing the window as the kiosk's routine becomes increasingly disturbing.

pages.title: Crowd Evolution!
pages.creator: XMetaGame
pages.description: Crowd Evolution! starts you with one person in a city full of competing groups. Gather people of your color and absorb smaller crowds to increase your numbers. Keep away from larger groups while trying to become the biggest crowd before time expires.

pages.title: Card Quest: 10 Minute Adventure
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Card Quest: 10 Minute Adventure is a card-battle game with a deck to build before combat. Choose a combination of creatures, attacks and healing abilities, then use it against the opposing force. Develop your collection and adjust the deck for another encounter.

pages.title: THE KULKA
pages.creator: Airem
pages.description: THE KULKA combines one-button flapping with a growing storm of bullets. Tap to move and dodge, collect experience gems from defeated enemies, and choose an upgrade when you level up. Keep evolving your attack while trying to survive longer.

pages.title: Backgammon Duel
pages.creator: PHATCAT Games Ltd
pages.description: Backgammon Duel brings the classic dice-and-checker game to the screen. Roll, select a checker and choose a legal destination on the board. Plan your moves around the available dice and try to bear off all your checkers before your opponent.

pages.title: Idol Livestream: Doll Dress Up
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Idol Livestream: Doll Dress Up lets you create an outfit for a doll before sending her onto a livestream. Combine clothing, hair, makeup and accessories, then watch the finished look on stage. Fashion contests add another way to compare and vote on styles.

pages.title: Diamond mosaic
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Diamond Mosaic lets you build pictures by placing small diamonds onto a numbered canvas. Choose an image, select the appropriate diamonds and use the pen to fill the matching areas. Continue adding the pieces until the picture is complete.

pages.title: Race Time
pages.creator: Tommaso Faraci
pages.description: Race Time is a three-lane car race with a boost meter charged by collecting gears. Move between lanes, activate the super boost and use its force against rival cars. Spend your earnings on upgrades or another vehicle for later races.

pages.title: Stick - Color War
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Stick - Color War asks you to shoot enemies with bullets that match their colors. Aim carefully at the colored stick figures and work through the stages toward boss encounters. New weapons give you more options as the fights continue.

pages.title: Vex X3M 2
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Vex X3M 2 sends a stunt bike through tracks with moving platforms, teleportation portals and kite-gliding sections. Accelerate, brake and tilt the bike to survive the hazards. Earn stars for bike skins and try the courses in easy or hard mode.

pages.title: Sprunki Mini Games
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Sprunki Mini Games combines music creation, coloring and picture comparisons in one collection. Arrange a nine-singer orchestra, decorate the available drawings or search for differences between images. Choose an activity and work through its characters and visual details.

pages.title: Granny's Classroom Nightmare
pages.creator: jimo game
pages.description: Granny's Classroom Nightmare traps you in an abandoned school with Granny searching the halls. Explore the rooms, uncover clues and solve puzzles that lead toward an escape. Watch your noise and surroundings while using the inventory and flashlight to investigate.

pages.title: Falling Art Ragdoll Simulator
pages.creator: Boombit S.A.
pages.description: Falling Art Ragdoll Simulator turns a tumbling character into a physics-based scoring challenge. Set the ragdoll falling and watch how it collides with the environment. Try different attempts to produce a harder fall and increase the points awarded.

pages.title: Skibronx Runner
pages.creator: Bonkersteengames
pages.description: Skibronx Runner takes you through city streets in two running modes. Reach the grocery store in the level challenge or travel farther in an endless attempt. Use jumps, double jumps, sliding and the water gun to deal with obstacles along the route.

pages.title: Puzzle lub
pages.creator: IT-Hype
pages.description: Puzzle Lub asks you to position pieces so they complete lines on the playfield. Finished lines disappear and add points, while the pace increases as you continue. Keep making space before the field fills and a new piece has nowhere to go.

pages.title: Tappus Free Kick Challenge
pages.creator: Neela Mediatech Private Limited
pages.description: Tappus Free Kick Challenge turns football free kicks into an aiming test. Drag to set direction and power, or curve the gesture to bend the ball around the goalkeeper. Hit the displayed targets and build a score to improve on your previous attempt.

pages.title: Fighter Legends Duo
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Fighter Legends Duo brings a selection of fighters into arenas ranging from temples to military locations. Move, punch, kick and use a special attack to defeat the opposing character. A second player can join with separate controls for a shared-screen duel.

pages.title: Bike Racing
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Bike Racing puts a motorcycle on courses with bends and obstacles to negotiate. Use the arrow keys to control acceleration, braking and steering while racing toward the finish. Collect power-ups along the track to help gain ground on rivals.

pages.title: Doodle Drop
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Doodle Drop follows a drawn kitten descending through platforms. Tap to drop at the right moment and keep the character moving through each level. Freeze or slow the platforms with power-ups when their movement makes the next descent difficult.

pages.title: Trial Bike Racing Clash
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Trial Bike Racing Clash combines stunt-bike riding with mission and skill challenges. Control the bike through hazardous zones, jump across obstacles and work toward the finish. Ride alone or use the separate controls to race a friend with customizable riders and bikes.

pages.title: Block Puzzle Ocean
pages.creator: SUN.STUDIO
pages.description: Block Puzzle Ocean asks you to fit shaped blocks into an eight-by-eight grid. Complete a row or column to clear its jewels and make space. Place each group carefully, since the run ends when no available piece can fit.

pages.title: Falling Asleep - Weird & Fun Game
pages.creator: 299games
pages.description: Falling Asleep - Weird & Fun Game turns guiding a sleepy character into a physics challenge. Use the mouse to control the movement and negotiate obstacles such as rotating hazards and fans. Bring the character to the finish to complete the stage.

pages.title: Sausage Rivals 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Sausage Rivals 3D puts sausage fighters into an arena full of dangerous fixtures. Move your character into punching range and push opponents toward hazards such as grills or knives. Stay clear of the same dangers while trying to be the last sausage standing.

pages.title: Turn Turn
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Turn Turn is a traffic-timing challenge about turning cars onto busy roads. Choose a safe opening and send each vehicle through without striking another car. Read the approaching traffic as the road layouts change between levels.

pages.title: Corona Airplanes Hidden
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Corona Airplanes Hidden asks you to find ten stars concealed in each airplane picture. Search the scene before time expires and select the shapes carefully. Repeated incorrect clicks reduce the remaining time, so accuracy matters as well as speed.

pages.title: SCP Laboratory Idle Secret
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: SCP Laboratory Idle Secret puts you in charge of developing a secret pixel-art laboratory. Hire employees, improve the facilities and research new technology as the organization grows. Follow story events while deciding which part of the lab needs attention next.

pages.title: Ant Colony
pages.creator: JetGames
pages.description: Ant Colony lets you build an ant force while gathering resources around an anthill. Catch other insects, upgrade the army and explore the surrounding area. Battles against other players give your colony a chance to climb the leaderboard.

pages.title: Minesweeper
pages.creator: K17 Games
pages.description: Minesweeper challenges you to uncover a grid without revealing a hidden mine. Use each number to judge how many neighboring squares contain danger. Work through the campaign or customize a board, marking likely mines while opening the safe spaces.

pages.title: Mr Herobrine
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description: Mr Herobrine is an archery adventure set in a blocky world. Aim at stickmen, monsters and bosses with carefully placed arrows, then improve the bow for tougher encounters. Keep progressing through new lands as the targets become more demanding.

pages.title: Stickman Archer Warrior
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Stickman Archer Warrior places enemy archers on a series of steps. Aim an arrow at the next opponent and choose from four special powers when the situation calls for help. Spend earned gold on new arrows as you advance through the chapters.

pages.title: Noob Steve Dark
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Noob Steve Dark sends Steve through levels threatened by flying axes. Dodge or jump past the weapons while collecting every green eye. Gathering the full set opens a portal that takes you onward to the next stage.

pages.title: Magical Fairy Fashion Look
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Magical Fairy Fashion Look helps Skyler and Sunny dress as fairies. Browse costumes, accessories and wings to create a complete fantasy outfit for each friend. Combine the available pieces until both characters have their own finished fairy look.

pages.title: Strike Half
pages.creator: Nevar Games
pages.description: Strike Half is a physics-based aiming puzzle about dividing an object into equal halves. Pull back the arrow and choose a shot that reaches the target through the obstacles. Adjust the angle to make the cut as close to the middle as possible.

pages.title: Just Golf
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Just Golf asks you to send a ball into the hole marked by a red flag. Hold to aim and release to shoot, using the guide to judge the route. Retry freely and try to collect the three stars placed around each level.

pages.title: Garden Tales
pages.creator: Azerion Games
pages.description: Garden Tales follows Willy the gnome through garden-themed matching puzzles. Swap flowers, fruit and mushrooms into groups of three, or make larger matches for boosters. Complete objectives involving debris, baskets and other garden obstacles to continue along the map.

pages.title: Real Bike Race
pages.creator: WebAvari
pages.description: Real Bike Race puts a motorcycle on racing courses with acceleration, braking and steering controls. Judge the bends and use the nitro option when you need extra speed. Practice handling the bike while working toward a better race result.

pages.title: Sinal Game
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Sinal Game tests whether you can identify the missing operator in a mathematical equation. Choose addition, subtraction, multiplication or division before moving to the next problem. Correct answers add two points, mistakes subtract one, and the challenge lasts sixty seconds.

pages.title: Commando Boat
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Commando Boat sends a speedboat behind enemy lines along a hazardous river. Dodge mines, logs, rocks and other boats, or destroy obstacles with gunfire. Keep the craft moving while deciding which threats to steer around and which to shoot.

pages.title: Spot The Difference
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Spot the Difference presents pairs of colorful pictures with details that do not match. Examine both scenes and select the changes to complete each stage. Find them without using clues to earn the full set of stars.

pages.title: Candy Fever
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Candy Fever is a Christmas-themed matching game with a different objective for each stage. Swipe candies into groups of three and work toward the requested result. Look for combinations that help clear the particular arrangement rather than matching pieces at random.

pages.title: Halloween 2020 Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Halloween 2020 Slide offers three seasonal pictures as sliding puzzles. Select a three-by-three, four-by-four or five-by-five layout and move its scrambled sections into position. Use the image details to work out which section needs to move next.

pages.title: Adam and Eve Aliens
pages.creator: Functu
pages.description: Adam and Eve Aliens leaves Adam stranded on an unfamiliar planet. Click on him and the surrounding objects to solve each scene's obstacle and avoid the alien dangers. Find the sequence that helps him continue the journey back to Eve.

pages.title: Cube Mania
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Cube Mania asks you to collect three identical blocks to remove them. Study the arrangement and choose matching pieces that help open the next set. Work through the changing levels by planning which blocks to clear first.

pages.title: Handless Millionaire
pages.creator: ISS Game Studio
pages.description: Handless Millionaire makes grabbing money a test of timing around a moving guillotine. Reach for the cash when an opening appears and withdraw before the blade closes. Judge its rhythm carefully as you try to increase the winnings.

pages.title: Geometric Solids
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Geometric Solids is a shape-recognition activity about three-dimensional figures. Look at the requested solid and choose the corresponding figure on the screen. Compare the shapes' features to make the correct selection before continuing to the next question.

pages.title: Hidden Cute Animals
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Hidden Cute Animals asks you to locate specific creatures within crowded pictures. Look carefully at similar-looking animals and select the correct ones before time runs out. Use a hint or magnifying glass when a small detail is hard to distinguish.

pages.title: Save Pilot
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Save Pilot puts you in control of a plane dodging bullets and rockets. Move through gaps in the incoming fire and collect shields or speed bonuses. Some opportunities let you shoot back while trying to keep the aircraft alive.

pages.title: Shooting Blocky Combat Swat GunGame Survival
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Shooting Blocky Combat Swat GunGame Survival puts block-styled fighters into armed arena battles. Choose from the available modes and use different guns, camouflage and attachments. Fight through the missions or take on other players in multiplayer combat.

pages.title: Cargo Ships Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Cargo Ships Jigsaw offers twelve ship pictures with three piece-count options. Choose 25, 49 or 100 pieces and rebuild the vessel and its surroundings. Start with recognizable edges or ship details, then connect the remaining sections of the image.

pages.title: Monkey Bridge
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Monkey Bridge makes a growing stick the monkey's way across gaps between platforms. Hold to extend the stick, then release when its length looks right for the crossing. Judge the distance carefully so the monkey has a safe route to the next platform.

pages.title: Hide and Seek Numbers
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Hide and Seek Numbers asks you to find numbers concealed within pictures. Examine each scene and select the digits you uncover. Keep searching the smaller details until the remaining numbers have been located.

pages.title: 4x4 Monster
pages.creator: SDV Imants Klava
pages.description: 4x4 Monster puts a heavy monster truck on rough off-road terrain. Drive over mountains and negotiate the obstacles along the route. Control the truck's movement carefully so it can keep climbing and make it through the next difficult section.

pages.title: River Coach Bus Driving Simulator Games 2020
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: River Coach Bus Driving Simulator Games 2020 puts a bus on routes through a water-themed driving setting. Steer through the checkpoints and work toward each level's destination. Keep the vehicle under control as the course asks for another turn or crossing.

pages.title: Wildlife Park Escape
pages.creator: games2mad
pages.description: Wildlife Park Escape traps you inside a closed wildlife park. Search for hidden objects and solve the puzzles around the grounds to find a way through the back gate. Connect the clues you discover as you explore for an exit.

pages.title: Russian Bus Simulator
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Russian Bus Simulator lets you drive a large bus through a Russian city setting. Practice steering and controlling the vehicle as you move along the roads. Adjust your approach to the space the bus needs around bends and other obstacles.

pages.title: Miami Taxi Driver 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Miami Taxi Driver 3D gives you passengers to collect and deliver around Miami. Drive to the pickup point, bring the customer to the destination and avoid damaging the taxi. Complete the trips as you work through the available levels.

pages.title: November Rain Match 3
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: November Rain Match 3 asks you to line up same-colored blocks in groups of at least three. Keep making combinations to increase your score and replenish the meter on the left. The run ends if that supply falls too low.

pages.title: Square Head Adventure
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Square Head Adventure challenges you to gather stars while staying alive among obstacles. Guide the square-headed character away from danger and look for the next collectible. Keep the attempt going to increase the number of stars you bring back.

pages.title: School Bus Driver
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: School Bus Driver puts you on school-bus missions with pickup locations to reach. Steer the large vehicle along the route and keep an eye on the time and fuel displays. Complete the current driving objective to continue through the levels.

pages.title: Monster Truck Offroad Driving Mountain
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Monster Truck Offroad Driving Mountain gives you a truck to steer between waypoints on mountain terrain. Complete each route while dealing with increasingly demanding off-road sections. Control your speed and use the brake when the next obstacle needs a careful approach.

pages.title: Little Mermaids Dress Up
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Little Mermaids Dress Up offers six mermaids with clothing, hairstyles and tail options to customize. Coordinate a top with the chosen fishtail, then add accessories such as a necklace or trident. Give each underwater character a different finished appearance.

pages.title: Flipping Color Box
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Flipping Color Box asks you to turn a jumping cube so its landing face matches the required color. Watch the next platform and choose the right flip before touching down. Keep matching the landings as the levels become more difficult.

pages.title: Candy Blocks
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Candy Blocks asks you to remove adjacent groups of two or more identical candies. Clear the whole board to complete a level, keeping in mind that an isolated piece cannot be removed. Plan each group so the remaining blocks still have matching neighbors.

pages.title: Mummy Hunter
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Mummy Hunter is an endless run through an Egyptian desert filled with mummies and obstacles. Deal with the enemies while avoiding dangers along the route. Collect coins to purchase stronger weapons as longer attempts become increasingly difficult.

pages.title: Road Racer
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Road Racer challenges you to keep a car moving among other vehicles without crashing. Watch the traffic ahead and move away from a closing gap. Continue driving safely while trying to extend your attempt.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Hair Day
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Hair Day starts with glue tangled in Hazel's hair. Follow the game's washing and styling activities, then choose a braid, colorful hair accessories and an outfit. Work through the makeover to give Hazel a fresh finished look.

pages.title: Pretty Princess Ball Dressup
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Pretty Princess Ball Dressup helps a princess choose clothing for a festival ball. Browse the available dresses and combine the pieces into an outfit for the celebration. Compare the options before settling on her finished appearance.

pages.title: Funny Dogs Puzzle
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Funny Dogs Puzzle lets you rebuild dog pictures from scattered jigsaw pieces. Select an image and drag the parts back into their original positions. Match the dogs' outlines and surrounding details to complete the scene.

pages.title: Mustang Shelby Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Mustang Shelby Puzzle offers six car pictures at four difficulty settings. Choose 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces, then reconnect the vehicle and its surroundings. Use the bodywork, wheels and background edges to guide the assembly.

pages.title: Prom Queen Dress up
pages.creator: DUGS
pages.description: Prom Queen Dress Up makes you the stylist for a character preparing for her graduation prom. Select a dress, choose a hairstyle and finish the outfit with accessories. Coordinate the available pieces to create her look for the evening.

pages.title: Funny Throat Surgery
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Funny Throat Surgery is a fictional clinic activity followed by a dress-up stage. Use the pictured tools to address the game's throat and mouth problems. Complete the treatment prompts, then choose a new outfit for the recovered character.

pages.title: 3 Cars
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: 3 Cars asks you to control three vehicles at the same time. Collect every flag while avoiding the traffic cones in their lanes. Missing a flag or touching an obstacle ends the attempt, so keep checking all three cars rather than following just one.

pages.title: Helix Up
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Helix Up puts a jumping ball among rotating rings and obstacles. Turn the helix with the keyboard or a mouse swipe to open its route upward. Keep the next ring in view while working toward the level's finish.

pages.title: Art Villages Differences
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Art Villages Differences presents paired village pictures with details that do not match. Select all the changes before time runs out and try to finish quickly for a higher score. Use the hint button when a remaining difference proves difficult to spot.

pages.title: Box Tower
pages.creator: Gamesdev
pages.description: Box Tower challenges you to stack moving boxes into a rising structure. Tap, click or press Space to drop the current box onto the one below. Watch its horizontal movement and choose a landing that keeps the tower growing.

pages.title: Kikker Memo
pages.creator: WPG Kindermedia
pages.description: Kikker Memo hides illustrations of Kikker and his friends behind face-down cards. Reveal pairs and remember their positions to find matching pictures. Collect butterflies to unlock new cards and increase the layout from four tiles toward larger boards.

pages.title: EG Penalty
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Penalty asks you to direct a football past the goalkeeper. Click or tap to aim at the goal and keep scoring as the pace increases. Three saves by the keeper bring the attempt to an end.

pages.title: Solitaire Solitaire
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Solitaire Solitaire offers classic solo card play with different modes to choose from. Move available cards into legal sequences and uncover the face-down cards beneath them. Use the draw pile when needed as you work toward clearing the layout.

pages.title: Pick a lock
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Pick a Lock challenges you to stop a moving indicator when it reaches the marked position on a lock. Repeat the timed inputs as the locks become harder. A single mistake resets the attempt, so watch each pass before tapping.

pages.title: Push the Dragon
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Push the Dragon is a movement puzzle about guiding dragons back to their eggs. Choose where to push each dragon and consider the route left for the others. Work through the board in an order that brings every creature to its goal.

pages.title: Paintball Gun Pixel 3D Multiplayer
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Paintball Gun Pixel 3D Multiplayer turns an angular, block-built world into a shooting arena. Choose among the available weapons and fight other players across different maps. Explore the routes through each environment to find a useful firing position.

pages.title: Jungle Jam
pages.creator: Vianim
pages.description: Jungle Jam is a jungle-themed matching puzzle. Bring matching pieces together in groups of three and keep finding combinations as the board changes. Look for matches that leave a useful arrangement for your next move.

pages.title: Falling Ballz
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Falling Ballz sends a stream of balls downward to break shapes below. Swipe or aim with the mouse to choose the shot's direction. Destroy as many targets as possible before the advancing shapes reach the top of the field.

pages.title: Santa Claus Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Santa Claus Challenge asks you to help Santa gather gifts by jumping at the right moment. Judge the next landing before launching him toward a present. Keep the jumps under control while trying to collect more of the Christmas gifts.

pages.title: Jelly Classic
pages.creator: YAKPI
pages.description: Jelly Classic is a matching puzzle about swapping jelly pieces into useful groups. Watch how each move changes the board and clear matches to increase the score. Keep finding combinations as new pieces enter the arrangement.

pages.title: Mixed World
pages.creator: Urbanduckgames
pages.description: Mixed World asks you to help small blue monsters remove red rivals from platforms. Push the enemies off while keeping the blue creatures in play. Work out the sequence of movements needed to clear each level's arrangement.

pages.title: Jetpack Rusher
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Jetpack Rusher sends Clarry through lasers, electric fields and incoming missiles with a bullet-powered jetpack. Control the flight to dodge the hazards and collect boosts along the route. Gather coins to purchase additional suits for later runs.

pages.title: Monster Rush
pages.creator: TopSoft UG
pages.description: Monster Rush is a tower-defense game about stopping monsters along a path. Place defensive towers where they can automatically attack the approaching creatures. Build a setup that covers the route and protects your possessions from the advancing wave.

pages.title: Crystal Gem Rose Quartz Dress Up Game
pages.creator: Missangest Games
pages.description: Crystal Gem Rose Quartz Dress Up Game lets you customize Rose Quartz's appearance. Browse her hairstyles and clothing, then combine the available pieces into a personal look. Explore different styles for the former leader of the Crystal Gems.

pages.title: Bouncing Balls Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Bouncing Balls Game asks you to launch balls at blocks before they reach the floor. Aim the shot to break as many targets as possible and collect bonuses that add more balls. Build a longer firing chain while keeping the descending blocks under control.

pages.title: Faraon
pages.creator: Ixel Games
pages.description: Faraon sends a hero through trapped rooms inside a pharaoh's pyramid to rescue a friend. Use the one-touch movement system to cross platforms and avoid enemies. Work through the dangerous chambers as you approach the adventure's ending.

pages.title: SuperHero VS Villain
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: SuperHero VS Villain helps Ladybug replace an outfit damaged during a rooftop chase. Look through the available clothing and choose a new superhero costume. Coordinate the pieces to create a finished look for her next appearance.

pages.title: Endless Lake
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Endless Lake challenges you to cross a route above the water without falling. Time your movements carefully while racing the clock to complete each round. Keep the next safe section in view as you try to improve your result.

pages.title: Pirate Booty
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Pirate Booty is a physics puzzle about knocking pirates off their ship and into the water. Place explosives where their force will push the crew away. Choose between tools such as fixed dynamite and a remotely detonated bomb to solve each arrangement.
